icon-button.accessible-name-note: Both aria-label and aria-labelledby provide an accessible name for screen readers. Use aria-label directly on the button, or aria-labelledby to reference an element with the label text elsewhere in the DOM.

appearances.label: Appearances
appearances.note: Combine an appearance with a color. Appearances cover every emphasis level, from the solid CTA to subtle ghost actions.

icon-button.badge-note: The badge is visual only. The accessible name of the icon button must include the badge context when relevant.
icon-button.button-group-note: Button Group is planned for a future release. It will support horizontal and vertical layout, disabled states, badge integration, icon-only buttons, separators, and active/selected states.

chromeless.note: Chromeless keeps the size box, removes background and border, and enlarges the icon (60% of the box). The whole scales with size × density. Hover or press to see the micro-interaction.

custom.label: Custom Color (CSS variables)
custom.note: Custom is not an arbitrary input. Define the custom color tokens in CSS.

icon-button.description: Attribute directive that turns buttons and anchors into icon-only Solaris-themed action buttons.

installation.note: Install the single Solaris package and import the directive.

motion.note: Press uses a subtle 0.99 scale and the loading spinner pops in. Toggle loading and badge to see the micro-interaction.

props.note: Props table coming soon, with the table component.

shape-radius.note: Radius controls corner rounding; the wide shape stretches the button horizontally.

size-density.note: Size and density combine into a 3×3 matrix, just like the standard button. The outer height always equals the control-height token of the combination.

icon-button.title: Icon Button
